Vision

遠望
百年つづく居場所を、チェンマイに。

Rikyu is an IP business at the crossing of wellness, entertainment and community. This house is its first.

The space is the doorway, the community is the engine, and the brand and the bonds we build are the asset. Starting from one house in Chiang Mai, we will grow new ventures out of the community and keep expanding.

What we aim for is sanpō-yoshi — good for the seller, good for the buyer, good for the world. Commerce where everyone involved gains, built to last a hundred years.

Restore. Play. Belong.
Chase ri, master kyū.
